title: Basals / TBR are not showing from AndroidAPS
body: ### Your environment: - Version: `c6c289d-2021.01.03` - Phone: OnePlus6T (Android 10, OxygenOS 10.3.7) - AndroidAPS version: v2.8.0 - xDrip settings: - Accept Treatments enabled (normal treatments and bolus are showing up) - Under Graph Settings > Show Basal TBR checked - In AndroidAPS: - xDrip status options are enabled (Show detailed IOB and Show BGI) ### Expected behavior Display basal and TBR on xDrip screen ### Actual behavior Basal rates are not displayed on the main screen. If I turn the Show Basal basal checkbox on it displays an error message at returning to the main screen: ``` Task deadlock on: executeOnExecutor! @4 ``` (or an other number) ### Steps to reproduce the behavior: Try to display basal/TBR from AAPS ### Screenshots

comments.body:
Looks like there is already an issue open for this, closing it: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1481
And related: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/46
